title: Restricted pro-etale q in comparison coordinates
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $i:Z\to T$ a proper morphism of schemes with $T$ quasi-compact. Use the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories $D(W_e,A)$ and $D(W_p,A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $C_W=\nu_W^*$, $F_e=Ri_{e,*}$, $F_p=Ri_{p,*}$, and let $G_e=i^\times$ use the identity-open compactification and its normalized exceptional adjunction; put $G_p=C_ZG_eR\nu_{T,*}$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Use the specified direct-image mate $b$, Hom transport $h$, origin map $\theta_N=C_ZG_e(j_N)$ induced by the comparison unit $j_N$, and counit compatibility property [def-weil-boundary-exceptional-comparison-data]. The same formulas define $h$ and $\theta$ on ambient derived objects, without asserting bijectivity there. Presenting the scalar ring at the module-value universe leaves these functors and formulas unchanged.

For $N\in D^+(T_e,A)$ satisfying the counit compatibility property, let $\mu_0:F_pC_ZG_eN\to C_TN$ be its specified arrow $C_T(\varepsilon^e_N)\circ b_{G_eN}^{-1}$ and define $\mu^p_{C_TN}=\mu_0\circ F_p(\theta_N^{-1})$. Use the canonical signed symmetries, maps $q^e,t^p$ and source isomorphism $s_{M,B}:C_Z(i_e^*M\otimes_A^LB)\cong i_p^*C_TM\otimes_A^LC_ZB$ of [def-weil-boundary-q-foundation], and the monoidal comparison $c_{W;M,N}:C_W(M\otimes_A^LN)\cong C_WM\otimes_A^LC_WN$ and projection components of [lem-weil-boundary-proetale-projection-comparison]. For bounded-below $M,N$ and invertible pro-etale projection component at $(G_pC_TN,C_TM)$, define
$$Q^p_{M,N}=h_{i_e^*M\otimes_A^LG_eN,\,C_T(M\otimes_A^LN)}\bigl(c_{T;M,N}^{-1}\circ t^p_{C_TM,C_TN}\circ F_p((1\otimes\theta_N)\circ s_{M,G_eN})\bigr).$$
For an object predicate $P$ on $D(T_e,A)$, define the compatibility property to mean that, for every normalized presentation of the canonical signed symmetries and all $M,N\in D^+(T_e,A)$ satisfying $P(M)$ and $P(N)$, with $G_eN$ bounded constructible, the counit and projection comparison properties and invertibility of both $\pi^e_{G_eN,M}$ and $\pi^p_{G_pC_TN,C_TM}$ imply
$$\theta_{M\otimes_A^LN}\circ C_Z(q^e_{M,N})=Q^p_{M,N}.$$
The consumer takes $P=D^b_{ctf}(T_e,A)$.
